messages:
sam-partners: Heads-up: Vectra sent assets for joint solution brief. Need quick checks: logo files (SVG?), quote approval, and marketplace tile variant.
ellie-design: They only attached PNGs. Requesting SVGs and a version without background gradients.
matt-legal: Any customer quotes in the brief? If yes, need signed approval or remove names.
nina-marketing: There's one quote with a first-name only. Ask partner to confirm written permission or we swap to anonymized quote. Also prefer CTA 'Get started'.
asset-bot: Uploaded: vectra-brief-v1.pdf (1.1MB), vectra-tile.png (320KB)
ellie-design: I mocked two quick comps: vectra-hero-solid.png and vectra-badge-compact.svg. Pushed links to thread. Small accessibility note: hero overlay text must be >=18px for AA contrast on this color.
matt-legal: Good. I'll draft an LOA template. If partner can supply signed quote approval, we can proceed. Otherwise swap quote to anonymized phrasing.
sam-partners: I'll request SVGs and signed quote from Vectra, and confirm 'Get started' CTA. Target publish next Wed.
__notes: Single Slack thread as continuous string, per agents.md. No title field.
